wolfram.note: Wolfram needs no definition before a symbol takes attributes; here the head is defined first, since ClearAttributes leaves an undeclared symbol alone.

caption: a declared head is Protected: the call stays unevaluated and says ClearAttributes::write
wolfram.note: Wolfram's Protected guards a symbol's definitions, not its attributes (only Locked does), so it sets the attribute and returns Null. Here a declared head's flags are shared engine state, so the call is refused.
